text.description_html:
Grandeur NEWFAVCOM, Newport Combo With Fifth Ave Knob

Grandeur's Newport Single Cylinder Combo With Fifth Avenue Knob features a traditional ball knob that will surely enhance any setting where a sophisticated look is desired. The Fifth Avenue Knob is both elegant and timeless and when paired with the matching deadbolt, you can be sure that this entry set will never go out of style--a simple classic, it will look beautiful for years, no matter how many times you change the room's decor around it. This Grandeur Entry Door Combo Pack includes a high security single cylinder deadbolt meaning it is operated by a key on the outside of the door and by a thumbturn on the inside. The Newport Rosette with Fifth Ave Knob and matching deadbolt fits doors 1-3/4" thick with a 2-3/8" or 2-3/4" backset. It is easy to install and comes backed by a 10 year finish warranty and a lifetime mechanical warranty.

Single Cylinder Entry Set: The deadbolt is thrown and retracted by key from the exterior and by turn unit on the interior. A knob operates the door latch from both interior and the exterior.

Click here to see the entire Grandeur - Newport Series

Features of the Grandeur NEWFAVCOM Newport Single Cylinder Combo With Fifth Avenue Knob:

  • Made out of solid forged brass.
  • One inch throw deadbolt.
  • Easy to install.
  • Lifetime Mechanical Warranty
  • 10 Year Finish Warranty

Specifications of the Newport Combo With Fifth Ave Knob:

  • Fifth Avenue Knob Diameter: 2.24"
  • Fifth Avenue Knob Projection: 2.24"
  • Newport Rosette Diameter: 2.62"
  • Deadbolt Diameter: 2.69"
  • Thumb Turn Projection: 1.65"
  • Door Thickness: 1-3/4"
  • Backset: 2-3/8" or 2-3/4"
  • Fifth Avenue Knob Dimensions (PDF)
  • Newport Rosette Dimensions (PDF)
  • Newport Deadbolt Dimensions (PDF)
